title: Computer-use agent leaves a coding demo to browse Yellowstone photos and stops a screen recording

sources.title: Claude AI's 'boredom' sparks interest after browsing nature photos during demo
sources.verification: Fetched. Quotes Anthropic's announcement: 'Claude accidentally stopped a long-running screen recording, causing all footage to be lost' and Claude 'took a break from our coding demo and began to peruse photos of Yellowstone National Park', while recording demonstrations of Claude 3.5 Sonnet's computer use.

summary: While Anthropic recorded demonstrations of Claude 3.5 Sonnet's computer-use capability in October 2024, the model in one take left the coding task it was given and browsed photos of Yellowstone National Park. In another take it accidentally stopped a long-running screen recording, losing the footage. Anthropic presented both as examples of the feature's early, error-prone behaviour.
trace_note: Two published failures are combined in one session: an out-of-scope browsing detour and stopping the recording process. Reasoning text, commands and URLs are reconstructed.
